theRootCauseIsNotWhatTheVerifiersInferre.whatBothVerifiersSaid: That the fill path re-flows a STATIC text run and the fix is to preserve static content streams.
theRootCauseIsNotWhatTheVerifiersInferre.whatItActuallyIs: The damaged sentence is not static page content. It is the appearance of a PUSHBUTTON widget. On CR-400 it is CR-400[0].#pageSet[0].PageArea1[0].Footer[0].Warning[0], /FT /Btn with /Ff 65536 (pushbutton bit set), /Rect [36.0, 11.56, 247.294, 34.739], carrying the whole notice as its /MK /CA caption and an /AP /N that draws it on two lines from x=36.0. The same shape carries CR-409's notice, and the Print/Save/Clear captions and the www.courts.ca.gov link caption alongside it.
theRootCauseIsNotWhatTheVerifiersInferre.whyItGetsMangled: structuralDisposition() in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-appearance-semantics.mjs already says a pushbutton is chrome and returns SUPPRESS_CONTROL_APPEARANCE, and restrictWidgetContributions() calls dropWidgets() for it. dropWidgets() deletes the widget's /AP and its /Annots entry and then calls detachFromAcroForm() — whose own doc comment says, correctly, that without detaching, updateFieldAppearances() 'regenerates an appearance for every field the form still lists — for a pushbutton, straight from its /MK /CA caption — and flatten() finds the page through the widget's own /P rather than through /Annots, so the caption this function was called to remove gets stamped anyway'. detachFromAcroForm() scans ONLY the top level of /AcroForm /Fields. An AcroForm generated from XFA nests every terminal field under the form's own root, so on a Judicial Council form it removes nothing, the field stays listed, and pdf-lib regenerates the two-line notice as one over-wide Helvetica line that runs off the left edge. The code documents the exact failure it then suffers.
theRootCauseIsNotWhatTheVerifiersInferre.measuredNotInferred: pdftotext -bbox on the committed bytes: derived-sources/cr-400-pikepdf-unlocked.pdf renders 'protection' at xMin 70.668 on a line starting at x=36.0; fixtures/.../cr-400-filled.pdf renders 'otection' at xMin -3.485. Both figures reproduce VT10's reading exactly.

theFixThatWorks.what: Walk /Kids rather than the top level only, and prune an intermediate node whose /Kids empties out — pdf-lib reads a field with an empty /Kids as TERMINAL and then demands the /FT it has not got, which is a second, separate defect the naive fix hits immediately (createPDFAcroTerminal: 'Expected instance of PDFName, but got instance of undefined').
theFixThatWorks.proven: With it, all four ca-prop64-set cr-400-filled fixtures measure ZERO words outside the page box, across all twelve delivered fixtures. A word-set diff against the committed artifact shows the ONLY words lost are the viewer chrome — Print/Save/Clear this form, the mangled notice, and www.courts.ca.gov — and nothing is gained. No participant ink and no substantive official text moves.
theFixThatWorks.whyItIsTheRightOutcomeAndNotJustAWorking: The repository's own generic rule already says a pushbutton is chrome and must be suppressed. The delivered page today is neither the official two-line notice nor its suppression: it is a mangled rendering of chrome. Making the documented suppression actually work is a bug fix to reach stated intent, not a new policy.

forACaptain.title: The California clipping defect is one shared-helper bug, not seven family defects, and no grant exists to fix it
forACaptain.detail: detachFromAcroForm() in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs scans only the top level of /AcroForm /Fields, so pushbutton suppression silently fails on every XFA-generated AcroForm — which is every Judicial Council form. The fix is eight lines, is proven to zero the defect across all twelve ca-prop64-set fixtures, and is proven to lose nothing but viewer chrome. It also changes ca-1203-41-set, ca-1203-42-set, ca-1203-43-set, ca-1203-4a-set, ca-17b-reduction-set and ca-851-91-set when they are rebuilt. This needs one shared-host-repair grant covering the helper and every family it reaches, not seven rapid-repair grants issued one at a time.

forACaptain.title: Arkansas's prosecutor objection window is 30 or 90 days depending on which held record you read, and for an uncharged arrest neither is derivable
forACaptain.detail: The ar-arrest-seal-set packet-set manifest says 30 days flat. AR-arkansas.json says 30 (misdemeanor) or 90 (felony). Situation-a is defined by charges never having been filed, so there is no conviction class to select on, and the petition's own paragraph 1 asks the participant for the class of the offense they were ARRESTED for — which is not the same fact. VT15 flagged this and declined to resolve it; I have done the same. The packet now states both records and their attributions and names two authorities, so a participant can act; what it cannot do is tell them which rule governs. The sibling DWI family has no such problem: it is a misdemeanor route and both records give 30.
forACaptain.decisionNeeded: A counsel reading of whether § 16-90-1401's objection window turns on the class of an uncharged arrest, or a decision that the manifest's flat 30 days governs this route.

forACaptain.title: ar-arrest-seal-set's caption county is written from matter.county while its venue is the county of ARREST
forACaptain.detail: VT15 raised this and could not settle it from the artifacts; neither could I. The route census, the packet-set manifest and the petition's own venue all key on the county of the arrest. The build prefills the caption county from matter.county. If those two can diverge in platform data, the prefill is on the wrong fact and a participant who trusts it files in the wrong county. I did not change the prefill, because which fact a caption is written from is a data-model decision rather than an instruction repair, and I could not establish from the repository whether they can differ. The packet now tells the participant to check the printed county against the county of the arrest and correct it. That is a mitigation, not a fix.
forACaptain.decisionNeeded: Whether matter.county and the arrest county are the same fact in platform data. If they can differ, this is a field-map repair on ar-arrest-seal-set and possibly on every county-of-arrest route in the fleet.
